openOriginalBands.title: Provayder orqali refund, uning kutish/xato holati va takror so‘rovdan himoya.

openOriginalBands.title: P2: marketing SMS/Telegram; xizmat xabari va reklama roziligini alohida boshqarish.

openOriginalBands.title: Mijoz faoliyati, soliq rejimi va savdo turiga tatbiq etiladigan amaldagi talablarni tekshirish.

openOriginalBands.title: Savdo, qaytarish, bekor qilish, aralash to‘lov va smena bo‘yicha provider oqimlarini xaritalash.
